name: personal-copilot-value-dashboard
description: Dockerized OpenTelemetry dashboard that measures GitHub Copilot ROI per session

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:worker && npm run test:coverage:installer && npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix web
scripts.test:coverage:installer: python -m coverage erase && python -m coverage run --source=scripts -m unittest discover -s test -p test_*.py && python -m coverage report --fail-under=90 --show-missing
scripts.test:coverage:backend: python -m coverage erase && python -m coverage run --source=backend.app -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p test_*.py && python -m coverage report --fail-under=90 --show-missing
scripts.calculate: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js calculate
scripts.calculate:fixture: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js calculate --config test/fixtures/value-model.json --day 2026-08-01 --fixture test/fixtures/otel-snapshot.json --no-publish --no-write
